name: Filliers Oude Graanjenever
base_ingredient: Malt wine from barley and grain (graanjenever: malt and grain only)
production: Malt wine distilled on site in copper stills
Oude (old-style) method; at least 15% malt wine
history: 1792 | First Filliers family member becomes a distiller (per The Gin is In)
1928 | Firmin Filliers creates Filliers Dry Gin 28
nose: Grain and wood, dusty faint spice
palate: Rye toast, burnt oak, baking spice
expressions: Filliers 8 Year Old Barrel Aged Genever | 40%
notes: ABV 38% taken from Master of Malt product title ('38 Degrees 5 Year Old'). Graanjenever is a protected appellation (Belgium, Netherlands, parts of Germany/France). Backlog year 1880 not confirmed.
